mustbeperfect/definitive-opensource.caption:
definitive-opensource is a curated map of the best apps you can actually use. 840 projects. 3.4k stars. MIT.

Ships with:
• AI, chat, editors, media, and productivity
• Windows, macOS, Linux, and self-hosted lists
• Active vs abandoned tags, plus security alerts
• Signal, Pi-hole, RustDesk, Open Web
